text: Behind a janitor's closet... there's a staircase that never ends.
SCP-087. Thirteen steps. A landing. Turn around. Thirteen more.
No lights. Your flashlight only reaches the next flight.
From somewhere below... a child is crying for help.
So you go down. Landing ten. Landing fifty.
But the crying... never gets any closer.
Then your flashlight catches something on the next landing.
A face. No pupils. No nose. No mouth.
You run. Back up the stairs. As fast as you can.
Landing one hundred. Landing two hundred.
The door should be right here... It isn't.
